children.name: Evidence
children.value: The vendor string and 1 comment fit the data

children.name: Evidence
children.value: Vorbis comment vendor string at 0x32 names "Lavf60.16.100"

children.name: Evidence
children.value: Vorbis comment ENCODER field at 0x43 names "Lavf60.16.100"

children.name: Evidence
children.value: The block size is 4,608 samples in every frame but the last; levels 3 to 12 use it.

children.name: Evidence
children.value: The highest linear predictor order is 8; 20 of 20 subframes are linear predictors.

children.name: Evidence
children.value: Every linear predictor has a coefficient precision of 15 bits, the precision every FFmpeg release run wrote in every level fixture of Encspect's tests. At more than 16 bits per sample libFLAC also writes it, so here only the block size tells the two encoders apart.

children.name: Evidence
children.value: Levels 4 to 12 set differing highest linear predictor orders, differing highest partition orders and a block size of 4,608 samples.

children.name: Evidence
children.value: The frames reach the highest linear predictor order and partition order of the lowest level they fit (the partition order in at least a fifth of the subframes).
